candidates.why_relevant: Central index of the Hungarian central bank/supervisor's machine-readable feeds. Confirmed feed list includes Hírek (/rss/5), Felügyeleti hírek (/rss/11), Fogyasztóvédelmi hírek (/rss/10), Legfrissebb kiadványok (/rss/7), Legfrissebb statisztikai kiadványok (/rss/12), Sajtószoba (/rss/15), Éves jelentés (/rss/1), MAP hírek (/rss/17), zöld (/rss/19), Elnök (/rss/21), piacfelugyelet (/rss/23). This is the single highest-value ongoing-monitoring endpoint for HU regulation/supervision.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll each /rss/N feed daily via feed parser; store guid+pubDate; feed 11 and 5 are the regulatory/supervisory trunk lines.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + direct fetch of feed index
queries_used: MNB RSS hírlevél feliratkozás dokumentumtár archívum

candidates.why_relevant: English-language mirror of the MNB feed index; useful for cross-checking translation coverage and for items MNB publishes only in EN or only in HU (asymmetry itself is a signal of what is aimed at international market participants).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll alongside the HU index; diff HU vs EN item sets to detect HU-only regulatory items.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search result + snowball from HU feed index
queries_used: MNB RSS hírlevél feliratkozás dokumentumtár archívum

candidates.why_relevant: Back-catalogue of MNB publications; gives historical depth for trend/baseline work that live feeds cannot supply.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off deep crawl to build a historical index; then rely on RSS for deltas.
queries_used: MNB RSS hírlevél feliratkozás dokumentumtár archívum

candidates.source_name: MNB Felügyeleti szabályozó eszközök (recommendations, circulars, methodology)
candidates.why_relevant: Canonical landing page for MNB soft-law supervisory instruments (ajánlások, vezetői körlevelek, módszertani kézikönyvek, mintaszabályzatok). Acts as pointer into every sub-archive of binding-in-practice supervisory expectations.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of the listing pages; hash PDF links to detect new/updated recommendations.
queries_used: MNB felügyelet szabályozás ajánlások vezetői körlevelek archívum konzultáció

candidates.source_name: MNB Felügyeleti szabályozó eszközök archívuma (incl. PSZÁF-era)
candidates.why_relevant: Archive of superseded supervisory instruments, including those issued by PSZÁF before its 2013-10-01 merger into MNB. Essential for reconstructing how a supervisory expectation evolved, and for spotting the pre-2013 institutional lineage that direct search misses.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off exhaustive crawl; note the separate ajanlasok-archivum and vezetoi-korlevelek subtrees.
queries_used: MNB felügyelet szabályozás ajánlások vezetői körlevelek archívum konzultáció

candidates.why_relevant: Frozen mirror of the old PSZÁF/supervisory site tree, organised by institution type (hitelintézetek, biztosítók, pénzügyi vállalkozások). A map of historical sources and terminology not reachable from the modern navigation.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Depth-limited crawl of the /archivum/Felugyelet tree; treat as read-only historical corpus.
queries_used: MNB felügyelet szabályozás ajánlások vezetői körlevelek archívum konzultáció

candidates.source_name: MNB Adatszolgáltatói Portál – Adatszolgáltatási naptár (reporting deadline calendar)
candidates.why_relevant: An actual, structured DEADLINE TRACKER: the supervisory data-reporting calendar for Hungarian regulated institutions. Closest thing in HU to a native compliance-deadline feed; drives operational vendor/bank timelines. Companion pages list the full adatszolgáltatás catalogue.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Inspect the calendar page's XHR/JSON backend before scraping HTML; monthly snapshot plus diff. Note the calendar reportedly excludes ad-hoc/daily/weekly reports.
queries_used: MNB adatszolgáltatási naptár határidők ERA STEFI felügyeleti adatszolgáltatás bekuldesi hataridok

candidates.source_name: MNB Európai szintű jogszabályok (EU-law gateway for HU supervised entities)
candidates.why_relevant: MNB's own curated map from EU-level acts (CRR/CRD, PSD2, MiCA, DORA etc.) into EUR-Lex, with the Hungarian-language versions. A ready-made crosswalk between the EU corpus and what the HU supervisor considers in scope.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Extract outbound EUR-Lex CELEX ids to seed an EU-law watchlist scoped to HU supervisory relevance.
queries_used: EUR-Lex magyar nyelvű jogszabály gyűjtemény pénzügyi szabályozás RSS értesítés

candidates.source_name: EUR-Lex – Hungarian interface and My EUR-Lex RSS alerts
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative Hungarian-language corpus of EU financial legislation plus a documented user-defined RSS alert facility (saved searches become feeds). Best mechanism for machine-readable horizon scanning of EU acts in HU, including national implementing-measure (NIM) records that reveal Hungarian transposition status and deadlines.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Build saved expert searches (subject matter = banking/payments, language = HU) and consume their RSS; alternatively use the EUR-Lex web services / CELLAR SPARQL for structured pulls.
queries_used: EUR-Lex magyar nyelvű jogszabály gyűjtemény pénzügyi szabályozás RSS értesítés

candidates.why_relevant: Free official consolidated text repository of Hungarian law with time-state (időállapot) navigation — lets you see exactly what a rule said on a given date and when amendments bite. Holds Hpt. (2013. évi CCXXXVII. tv.) and the rest of the banking/payments statute base. Also fronts the Magyar Közlöny archive.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track a watchlist of statute ids (stable URLs like /jogszabaly/2013-237-00-00) and diff time-states; note the parallel hosts njt.jog.gov.hu, uj.njt.hu, or-archiv.njt.hu.
queries_used: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár njt.hu Magyar Közlöny archívum letöltés hitelintézeti törvény

candidates.why_relevant: Point of legal truth and the earliest possible signal: every Hungarian act, government decree, MNB decree and Hivatalos Értesítő notice appears here on publication day, typically before secondary coverage. Signed PDFs, searchable by date/issue.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily poll of the issue list; download PDFs and keyword-filter for pénzforgalom / hitelintézet / MNB rendelet; keep the signed PDF as evidence.
queries_used: magyarkozlony.hu hivatalos lap letöltés archívum lapszámok

candidates.why_relevant: Deep historical digitisation of the gazette for long-run regulatory history beyond what njt/magyarkozlony expose. Commercial archive — access and reuse terms matter.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual, licensed lookups only for specific historical questions; do not bulk-harvest.
queries_used: magyarkozlony.hu hivatalos lap letöltés archívum lapszámok
candidates.observed_blocker: Subscription-based archive (search result indicates licensed collection access)

candidates.why_relevant: Government consultation portal — the formal channel where draft legislation (including finance-ministry drafts affecting banking/payments) is opened for comment, with stated deadlines. Consultation windows in HU are often very short (reported ~8 days), so feed-based monitoring is the only realistic way to catch them.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily scrape of the consultation listing plus kormany.hu/dokumentumtar filtered by categories/ministry query params; extract the véleményezési határidő from each item.
queries_used: kormany.hu társadalmi egyeztetés jogszabálytervezet véleményezés pénzügyminisztérium

candidates.why_relevant: Independent Hungarian legislation-tracking aggregator that consolidates draft laws out for public consultation in one list — a native-language substitute for the commercial horizon-scanning trackers, and a cross-check that nothing was quietly posted and pulled from the government portal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Light periodic scrape as a corroborating signal only; always resolve back to the primary kormany.hu document before recording a fact.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search, snowballed from consultation query
queries_used: kormany.hu társadalmi egyeztetés jogszabálytervezet véleményezés pénzügyminisztérium

candidates.why_relevant: Article-level compendium tying CRR/CRD level-1 text to RTS/ITS, EBA guidelines and Q&As. The fastest way to establish, for any prudential obligation binding a Hungarian bank, the full stack of level 2/3 material and its application dates.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as a lookup/enrichment layer keyed by article id rather than a crawl target; pair with the EBA news RSS for change detection.
queries_used: EBA interactive single rulebook ESMA EIOPA deadline calendar have your say consultations tracker

candidates.why_relevant: Same function as the EBA tool for securities/markets files (MiFID II/MiFIR, MiCA-adjacent); relevant to the investment-services side of Hungarian banks.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Lookup/enrichment layer; monitor ESMA news feed for rulebook updates.
queries_used: EBA interactive single rulebook ESMA EIOPA deadline calendar have your say consultations tracker

candidates.source_name: KPMG Hungary – Financial Risk & Regulation hírlevél
candidates.why_relevant: Big-4 Hungarian-language regulatory newsletter series (FRR) that summarises MNB and EU developments for HU financial institutions, with interpretation and implementation timelines. Useful as a curated horizon-scanning digest and as a signal of what practitioners consider material. Archive of past issues is browsable.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Subscribe to the newsletter into a monitored mailbox; link out rather than reproducing text (copyright). Note observed issue URLs follow /hu/hu/home/tanulmanyok/<year>/<mm>/frr-*.html.
queries_used: Lexology Hungary banking regulation updates law firm newsletter jogi hírlevél pénzügyi szabályozás 2026

candidates.source_name: Lexology – Hungary banking & financial regulation feed
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregates Hungarian and international law-firm alerts on HU banking/payments rules; in practice the fastest English-language early warning on HU legislative moves (e.g. crypto/MiCA alignment bills, cyber decrees) with citation back to the primary instrument.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Configure a Hungary + banking/financial-services email alert into a monitored mailbox; harvest metadata and the cited primary sources, not the article body.
queries_used: Lexology Hungary banking regulation updates law firm newsletter jogi hírlevél pénzügyi szabályozás 2026
candidates.observed_blocker: Free account generally required for full article access (hypothesis; not verified this run)

candidates.why_relevant: Regional legal-news aggregator with a Hungary section; good for actor mapping (which firms/advisers work on which regulatory files) and for catching regulatory changes framed as deal/market news.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency scrape or RSS if offered; use for actor/entity extraction rather than as an authority.

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly scrape of hirek-aktualitasok and sajtokozlemenyek listings; note legacy PDF quarterly reports under /Public/jelentesek/ for historical depth.
queries_used: Magyar Bankszövetség hírlevél szabályozási figyelő jogszabályfigyelés bankok

candidates.why_relevant: Commercial regulatory-change monitoring covering 140+ jurisdictions and 1,400+ authorities, payments-focused. Relevant as a benchmark for what a paid HU feed would deliver, and as a potential licensed shortcut — but it is a vendor claim, not a verified HU-coverage fact.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Do not scrape. Evaluate via demo/trial if HU-specific depth needs to be procured rather than built.
queries_used: regulatory horizon scanning tracker Hungary financial deadlines RegTech

candidates.why_relevant: Second commercial horizon-scanning vendor with published methodology material (obligation mapping, alerting on effective dates). Its public guides are a usable template for designing our own HU deadline tracker even if we never buy the product.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Read public guides for methodology only; no harvesting of product data.
queries_used: regulatory horizon scanning tracker Hungary financial deadlines RegTech

candidates.why_relevant: Hungarian national cybersecurity institute's RSS endpoints. Adjacent-but-material to banking supervision because DORA/NIS2 implementation and HU cyber decrees (e.g. the 2026 cybersecurity amendment reported by law firms) create binding deadlines for financial entities.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Subscribe to the listed feeds; filter for pénzügyi/DORA/NIS2 terms.
queries_used: MNB RSS hírlevél feliratkozás dokumentumtár archívum

negative_findings.description: Searched in English for a Hungary-specific regulatory horizon-scanning tracker or compliance-deadline product.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only generic global RegTech vendors surfaced (Vixio, FinregE, Regulativ, Kodex AI, Mitti listicles). None demonstrated Hungary-specific coverage in public material; the search engine itself noted no HU-tailored tracking systems in results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: There is no off-the-shelf HU deadline tracker to lean on: the deadline dimension must be assembled from MNB's adatszolgáltatási naptár, Magyar Közlöny hatálybalépés dates, and EUR-Lex application dates.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Hungarian for a dedicated Magyar Bankszövetség regulatory-monitoring newsletter ('szabályozási figyelő hírlevél', 'jogszabályfigyelés').
negative_findings.result_summary: No public, subscribable regulatory newsletter endpoint was found for the Banking Association; only news, press-release and working-group listing pages plus legacy quarterly PDF reports.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The association's regulatory positioning is likely circulated to members only, so its influence on drafts must be inferred from press releases and working-group pages rather than captured directly.

negative_findings.description: The acronym 'MNB' is noisy in Hungarian search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Queries for 'MNB archívum' returned Magyar Nemzeti Levéltár (MNL, national archives), penzvero.hu (mint) newsletters, and a third-party 'MNB Archívum' news-tag aggregator (rsshirek.hu/tag/mnb) rather than the central bank.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated HU query expansion must anchor on 'Magyar Nemzeti Bank' or site:mnb.hu, otherwise the collector will ingest archives-of-the-nation and coin-mint content as central-bank material.

negative_findings.description: No liveness verification was attempted for most URLs in this slice; only https://www.mnb.hu/rss was actually fetched this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: The feed index at mnb.hu/rss returned a parseable list of 11 named feeds. All other URLs are recorded from search results and are unverified pending the deterministic liveness pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Per playbook, unfetched or failed URLs are hypotheses; the verification pass must resolve them and distinguish bot-defence (403) from relocation (404). njt.hu in particular exposes four parallel hosts (njt.hu, njt.jog.gov.hu, uj.njt.hu, or-archiv.njt.hu) that need canonicalisation.

negative_findings.description: Looked for an explicit MNB public-consultation ('konzultációs dokumentum' / 'vitaanyag') portal analogous to EBA/EU 'Have your say'.
negative_findings.result_summary: No dedicated MNB consultation portal surfaced in this run; MNB soft-law appears to be published as finished instruments under felugyeleti-szabalyozo-eszkozok rather than through an indexed consultation stage.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If MNB has no open consultation register, pre-decisional intelligence on HU supervisory expectations has to come from kormany.hu társadalmi egyeztetés, Bankszövetség working groups, and EU-level consultations instead.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed machine-readable feed for Hungarian legislative output itself — Magyar Közlöny and njt.hu were not confirmed to expose RSS/API endpoints in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe magyarkozlony.hu and njt.hu for RSS, sitemap.xml, or JSON endpoints; if absent, build a dated-issue-list poller and a statute time-state differ.

coverage_gaps.description: SZTFH (Szabályozott Tevékenységek Felügyeleti Hatósága) was referenced only indirectly (crypto-oversight role, via a law-firm summary); its own publication/archive endpoints were not scouted.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated HU query set on 'SZTFH közlemények / határozatok / RSS' and add its document archive as a candidate; it is a second HU financial-adjacent supervisor besides MNB.

coverage_gaps.description: EU-level consultation and deadline aggregators scoped to HU relevance (Commission 'Have your say', EBA/ESMA/EIOPA consultation registers and their RSS) were identified only conceptually; no concrete feed URLs were captured this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Capture the concrete RSS/ATOM endpoints for ec.europa.eu 'Have your say', EBA consultations, ESMA consultations, and add them as pointer candidates with HU-relevance filters.

coverage_gaps.description: EUR-Lex national implementing measures (NIM) for Hungary — the structured record of whether and when HU transposed a given directive — were not directly enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a NIM query against EUR-Lex (or CELLAR SPARQL) filtered to Hungary and financial-services directives to derive a transposition-deadline tracker.

coverage_gaps.description: Hungarian professional/practitioner aggregators beyond KPMG (e.g. ado.hu, jogaszvilag.hu, arsboni, Deloitte/PwC/EY HU alerts, jogtar.hu / Wolters Kluwer commercial legal databases) were not systematically scouted.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Second pass with HU queries on 'jogi hírlevél pénzügyi intézmények', 'jogtár előfizetés', 'adó.hu pénzügyi szabályozás' to fill the commentary/interpretation layer.

coverage_gaps.description: The MNB Adatszolgáltatói Portál calendar (aszp.mnb.hu) and the STEFI/ERA systems mix public calendar pages with authenticated submission systems; the public/private boundary is unclear.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Determine which aszp.mnb.hu pages are anonymously reachable and whether the calendar is backed by a JSON API; do not attempt access to ERA/STEFI authenticated areas.

brief: Hungary's regulatory pointer/archive layer is unusually well-provisioned at the official end and thin at the aggregator end. MNB anchors it with a confirmed 11-channel RSS index (mnb.hu/rss, with /rss/11 Felügyeleti hírek and /rss/5 Hírek as the regulatory trunk lines), a layered soft-law archive reaching back through the PSZÁF era, and — most valuable for the deadline topic — a genuine supervisory reporting calendar on the Adatszolgáltatói Portál; njt.hu and magyarkozlony.hu supply the authoritative statute and gazette corpora with time-state and signed-PDF evidence, while EUR-Lex's Hungarian interface plus its saved-search RSS is the only clean machine-readable route into EU-law-in-Hungarian. Pre-decisional coverage is the weak flank: consultation intelligence rests on kormany.hu's társadalmi egyeztetés portal (with famously short comment windows) and the independent torvenyfigyelo.hu aggregator, since no MNB consultation register surfaced. No Hungary-specific commercial horizon-scanning product was found — the global RegTech vendors (Vixio, FinregE) are paywalled and unproven on HU, so a HU deadline tracker must be assembled in-house from gazette hatálybalépés dates, MNB's calendar, and EUR-Lex application dates.
